affectedArea: Admin destructive application rejection / approval race
canonicalTest: New controlled PostgreSQL regression; adjacent to VERIFY-011
steps: Complete real uploads, submission and document verification.
Hold the outbox table with an independent PostgreSQL transaction.
Start approval and observe it waiting to insert its event, after upload checks and ACTIVE update within its open transaction.
Start rejection; it reads the last committed PENDING_APPROVAL state, deletes storage, and queues its event insertion.
Release the outbox holder: approval commits, then stale rejection purges the approved dealer.
expected: Approval wins: rejection returns 422 and preserves approved dealer, membership and assets.
rootCause: rejectDealer checks state and removes storage before its transaction; deletion has no locked fresh state check.
plan: Dedicated stacked fix immediately after BUG-002 remote CI passes; no purge changes bundled in BUG-002.
ci: PASS at d29d9b9: CI366 attempt2 / Security515; first font-loader failure retained separately

title: Dealer inventory skips equal-time vehicles after its first page
steps: In isolated published-stock fixture set 51 vehicle createdAt values to the same valid millisecond timestamp.
GET /v1/dealer/vehicles?limit=1 using a real owner cookie, then follow page.nextCursor.
Compare visited IDs with authoritative dealer-scoped database rows; restore original fixture timestamps.
expected: All 51 rows visited once in createdAt/id order.
rootCause: inventory uses timestamp-only cursor and strictly earlier-date filter despite createdAt/id sorting
plan: Dedicated layer after the primary bug stack; no inventory source changes included in BUG003.

affectedArea: local private KYC PDF signed-preview MIME metadata
steps: Through real owner cookie/API in isolated certification DB, presign a PAN_CARD document declaring application/pdf.
PUT valid marked PDF bytes using the actual signed upload URL, then commit the document.
Read the actual document key through a signed private URL and compare HTTP MIME, bytes, ownership and UPLOADED database state.
expected: Valid PDF returned as application/pdf with private no-store caching.
actual: HTTP200 image/jpeg; valid PDF bytes and correct ownership preserved.
rootCause: Local adapter discards declared MIME metadata and private delivery guesses from UUID-ended document key, defaulting to JPEG.
scope: Actual local-storage workflow; deployed S3/R2 not tested.
plan: Dedicated later stacked layer; no private MIME implementation change in BUG-004.
